title: A study in people with advanced extrapulmonary neuroendocrine cancer to compare obrixtamig plus carboplatin and etoposide treatment with standard chemotherapy.
official: A Phase III, multi-center, open-label, randomised, controlled trial of intravenous obrixtamig in combination with carboplatin and etoposide vs. carboplatin and etoposide as first-line therapy in DLL3-positive patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic extrapulmonary neuroendocrine carcinomas.
summary: Main objective: The trial will compare obrixtamig in combination with carboplatin and etoposide vs. carboplatin and etoposide in patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic epNEC, previously untreated and tested positive. The primary objective is to demonstrate the superiority in overall survival (OS).
conditions: advanced or metastatic extrapulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma

interventions.name: Avtozma 20 mg/mL concentrate for solution for infusion.
Etoposid Hikma 20 mg/ml Konzentrat zur Herstellung einer Infusionslösung
Carboplatin Hikma 10 mg/ml Konzentrat zur Herstellung einer Infusionslösung

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. Patients with poorly differentiated unresectable locally advanced or metastatic epNEC with Ki-67 >20% or mitotic rate mitotic rate with number of mitoses >20 per 2 mm2, regardless of primary site (including site of unknown origin)
2. 2. Patients with tumours with mixed histologies are eligible only if neuroendocrine carcinoma component is predominant and represents more than 70% of the overall tumour tissue
3. 3. No prior systemic treatment for unresectable locally advanced or metastatic epNEC (except for the completed one cycle of standard platinum + etoposide). Prior peri-operative chemotherapy or -radiation for curative intention is allowed if at least 6 months have elapsed between completion of this therapy and diagnosis of unresectable locally advanced or metastatic disease
4. 4. Patients who have finished one cycle of standard platinum + etoposide regimen as first-line treatment (Cycle 0: etoposide with carboplatin or cisplatin, administered at a minimum dose of cisplatin 75 mg/m2 or carboplatin AUC 5 and etoposide 80 mg/m2) prior to randomisation
5. 5. Patients must comply with criteria for receiving further chemotherapy treatment as first-line SoC treatment within 28 days after the start of the initial chemotherapy (Cycle 0)
6. 6. Adequate archival FFPE tumour tissue, as specified in the Laboratory Manual, must be available for central laboratory analysis of DLL3 expression status. Tumours must be positive (as defined in the diagnostic study protocol) for DLL3 expression status assessed by investigational VENTANA DLL3 (SP347) RxDx Assay
7. 7. Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) score of 0 or 1
8. 8. Male or female participants ≥18 years old and at least at the legal age of consent in countries where it is greater than 18 years at the time of signature of the informed consent form (ICF)
9. Further inclusion criteria apply.
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1. Presence of leptomeningeal disease and/or carcinomatous meningitis
2. 2. Patients with diagnosis of Merkel cell carcinoma or medullary thyroid carcinoma
3. 3. Patients with neuroendocrine prostate cancer
4. 4. Patients with well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumours of any grade according to the WHO classification, 5th edition
5. 5. Patients with a history of well differentiated NET tumour that transformed into poorly differentiated NEC
6. 6. Previous treatment with obrixtamig or other DLL3-targeting therapies (e.g. TcEs, cell therapies, antibody-drug conjugates, or radiopharmaceuticals)
7. 7. Previous treatment with anti-PD-1 or PD-L1 therapies during the one cycle of standard platinum + etoposide first-line chemotherapy (Cycle 0)
8. 8. Toxicity from previous treatments that has not resolved to ≤ CTCAE Grade 1 or grade prior to Cycle 0. Participants with alopecia any grade, CTCAE ≤Grade 2 asthenia/fatigue, amenorrhea/menstrual disorders any grade, CTCAE ≤Grade 2 peripheral neuropathy, and/or CTCAE ≤Grade 2 endocrinopathies controlled by replacement therapy, and toxicities, which are considered irreversible but stable for at least 4 weeks, per Investigator judgement may be eligible
9. Further exclusion criteria apply.
